## Description

Members previously used a narrow list and lacked workspace context beside navigation. UI-01 shows the trusted workspace name, ordinary Connect/Members/Audit links, a 32px title, visible focus and full-width Members content. Audit keeps its form, optional script and Save/Test behavior. Existing invitation and pending sections remain visible in this increment.

This is the first PR in UI-01 → UI-02 → UI-03 → UI-04, based on main `9507e751`. It also records the approved Refined tabs plan and implementation evidence. No merge or deployment is claimed.

The source stack is [published](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5ae98b9f2a7f4832e466ae5285d9698e99baab05/review-evidence/ui-01/37046bbd1426566d90bf1a32f8578584d7173060/v1/review/source-stack-push.json); UI-03 now targets UI-02. No merge or deployment occurred.

Ordinary, browser, type/build and self-hosted gates pass with documented input equivalence. Hosted offline build passed on retry. Metrics retain explained existing MI/test findings; required CRAP goals pass, with no exception.

**Overall merge status: blocked; Draft.** Three earlier Linux AMD64 image attempts failed or were interrupted before current-main runtime proof; the new local image gate is pending. The required image gate and independent authorized current-head owner/team approval remain outstanding. Local checker eligibility supplies neither. Manager accepted the unchanged source and retained quality reasons; the new checker review is accepted; final gate verification remains pending.
